## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) · $0.75/M blended · $0.2 in / $2.4 out per 1M tokens · [alibabacloud.com](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing)

<sub>[price source](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing): USD per 1M tokens, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Singapore (International deployment scope), qwen3-30b-a3b-thinking-2507 (thinking mode only; output = chain of thought + answer). Chinese-mainland/Global deployments priced differently; free quota, batch and context-cache discounts excluded. Currency: USD. ### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~17.2GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-4bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~32.4GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-8bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~18.8GB
ollama run qwen3:30b
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~37.1GB
ollama run qwen3:30b-a3b-thinking-2507-q8_0
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
ollama run hf.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
ollama run hf.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**MLX (Mac)** · install: with uv `uv tool install mlx-lm` · or `pip install mlx-lm` · Apple silicon Macs only, text only.

```sh
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~17.2GB
mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-4bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-4bit
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~32.4GB
mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-8bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-MLX-8bit
```
